description: Pinned workflow provenance and guarded workflow refresh
changelog:
**Improvements:**
- Persist the selected workflow identity, immutable source ref, and content hash in `.trellis/workflow-provenance.json`.
- Require immutable Marketplace refs and verify workflow content against the Marketplace index hash before installation.
- Add `trellis workflow --verify` and scope archive auto-commit to the exact archive destination.
notes: Run npm install -g @pennixrv/trellis@beta then trellis update. Existing projects without workflow provenance must explicitly select their workflow again before provenance verification is available. No --migrate required.
